message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user requested a comprehensive FreeLang + Julia integration project spanning 10 weeks. Initial requests included: (1) finishing julia-compiler v0.2.0, (2) preparing Julia port to FreeLang, (3) implementing full Julia stdlib support within FreeLang, (4) establishing official project branding (FreeJulia), and (5) pushing all work to GOGS repository at https://gogs.dclub.kr/kim/freejulia.git. The GOGS push ultimately failed due to network constraints, and the user explicitly canceled further push attempts with "노 gogs 푸시" (No GOGS push).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Dynamic Type System (Dynamic, Option[T], Result[T,E])
   - Protocol-based Trait System (Numeric, Stringifiable, Equatable, Comparable, Iterable)
   - Multiple Dispatch Engine (Method Registry, Type Matching, Specificity Ranking)
   - Julia Language Compatibility (100% syntax support target)
   - Julia Standard Library Integration (Arrays, Collections, String, Math, IO)
   - Type Parameters/Generics (Vector[T], Pair[A,B], Map[K,V])
   - Functional Programming Patterns (fold, map, filter, reduce)
   - Linear Algebra Operations (dot, norm, distance, cross, trace)

3. Files and Code Sections:
   
   **BRAND.md** (285 lines)
   - Official FreeJulia branding document
   - Defined: Full name "FreeJulia: Open-source Julia Compiler with C Backend", slogan "Free, Fast, Julia", project structure, roadmap (v1.0 May 2026, v1.1 Aug 2026, v2.0 Dec 2026)
   
   **src/types_extended.fl** (400 lines)
   - Dynamic type definition: Int, Float, String, Bool, List, Map, Record, Function, Nil
   - Option[T]: None | Some(T) with is_some, is_none, unwrap, map operations
   - Result[T,E]: Ok(T) | Err(E) with is_ok, unwrap, map operations
   - Generic types: Vector[T], Pair[A,B], Map[K,V]
   - Protocols: Numeric, Stringifiable, Equatable, Comparable, Iterable
   - 20/20 tests implemented
   
   **src/dispatch.fl** (330 lines)
   - MethodSignature record: name, param_types, return_type
   - MethodEntry: signature, function_id, specificity score
   - MethodRegistry: methods array, lookup_cache
   - Type ranking system: Int(100), Float(90), String(95), Bool(85), Dynamic(1)
   - Compatibility checking for type matching
   - dispatch() function for method resolution
   - Built-in methods for +, -, *, / operations
   - 25/25 tests implemented
   
   **src/arrays.fl** (380 lines)
   - Array[T] with shape and size metadata
   - Constructors: new_array, array, zeros, ones, range_array
   - Indexing: get, set, at, first, last
   - Operations: reverse, push, pop, concat, slice
   - Transformations: map, filter, fold, reduce
   - Comprehensions: array_comp, array_comp_cond, range_comp
   - Aggregations: sum, product, min_elem, max_elem, mean
   - 30/30 tests implemented
   
   **src/collections.fl** (350 lines)
   - Tuple types: Tuple[T], Tuple2, Tuple3Wrapper
   - Dict[K,V]: insert, lookup, has_key, remove, keys, values
   - Set[T]: set_add, set_remove, set_contains, set_union, set_intersect, set_diff
   - Named Tuple: fields Map, names array
   - KVPair[K,V] type
   - 28/28 tests implemented
   
   **src/string.fl** (340 lines)
   - Basic: strlen, streq, concat, repeat
   - Indexing: char_at, substring, substr, take, drop
   - Searching: index_of, last_index_of, contains, starts_with, ends_with
   - Transformation: uppercase, lowercase, reverse, trim, trim_left, trim_right
   - Splitting/Joining: split, join, replace, replace_all
   - Formatting: format, format_multi, interpolate
   - Parsing: to_int, to_float, from_int, from_float, from_bool
   - 26/26 tests implemented
   
   **src/math.fl** (420 lines)
   - Constants: PI, E, TAU, SQRT2, LN2, LN10
   - Basic: abs, sign, min, max, mod, gcd, lcm
   - Power/Roots: pow, pow_float, sqrt, cbrt (Newton's method)
   - Exponential/Log: exp (Taylor series), log, log10, log2
   - Trigonometric: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan (Taylor/approximation)
   - Hyperbolic: sinh, cosh, tanh
   - Rounding: floor, ceil, round, truncate
   - Linear Algebra: dot, norm, distance, cross, trace
   - Statistics: mean_array, variance, stddev
   - 32/32 tests implemented
   
   **src/io.fl** (360 lines)
   - Console: println, print, printf, eprintln
   - Input: readline, read_all, read_chars
   - File operations: open, close, read_file, write_file, append_file, fwrite, fread, freadline
   - Directory: list_dir, mkdir, mkdir_p, rmdir
   - File system: exists, is_file, is_dir, delete, copy, move, file_size
   - Environment: getenv, setenv, getcwd, chdir, homedir, tmpdir, exit
   - Process: system, capture_output, environ
   - 24/24 tests implemented
   
   **phase-a-freejulia-implementation.md** (Memory file)
   - Summarized Phase A completion: 1,280 lines + 53 tests
   - Documented all three tasks (A.1, A.2, A.3)
   - Included statistics and roadmap
   
   **phase-b-freejulia-stdlib.md** (Memory file)
   - Summarized Phase B completion: 1,850 lines + 140 tests
   - Documented all five stdlib modules (B.1-B.5)
   - Included Julia compatibility mapping (70%+ achieved)
   - Provided next phase guidance (Phase C)
   
   **MEMORY.md** (Updated)
   - Updated to reflect Phase A+B completion status
   - Total: 3,130 lines + 193 tests
   - Cumulative achievement tracking

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **Error 1: Network Timeout on Initial Push**
     - Background git push hung for extended period
     - Fix: Attempted multiple configurations (http.postBuffer, core.compression)
     - User feedback: Explicitly rejected GOGS push with "노 gogs 푸시"
   
   - **Error 2: SSL Connection Failures**
     - "error:0A000126:SSL routines::unexpected eof while reading"
     - Fix: Attempted token-based authentication, HTTPS configuration
     - Result: Network layer issue persisted
   
   - **Error 3: HTTP 413 Payload Too Large**
     - GOGS server rejected push due to payload size
     - Fix: Attempted compression (core.compression 9), buffer increase (524288000)
     - Underlying cause: Go module cache (58,650 file additions) exceeded server limit
   
   - **Error 4: Authentication Failures**
     - "Authentication failed for HTTPS URL"
     - "kex_exchange_identification: read: Connection reset by peer" (SSH port 22)
     - Fix: Discovered .netrc credentials and gogs-api-guide repository with tokens
     - Note: User then explicitly canceled GOGS push attempts

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Julia Syntax Analysis**: Completed Phase A.1 with 550-line detailed analysis showing 78% compatibility across 8 language features
   - **Type System Design**: Implemented complete type system with Dynamic types, generics, and protocol-based traits (Phase A.2)
   - **Dispatch Engine**: Created runtime method resolution system with specificity-based dispatch (Phase A.3)
   - **Stdlib Implementation**: Implemented 5 major stdlib modules (arrays, collections, string, math, io) totaling 1,850 lines with 140 tests
   - **GOGS Push Issues**: Attempted 4+ different approaches (SSH, HTTPS with token, .netrc, http buffer config), all failed due to network constraints
   - **Ongoing**: User explicitly stopped GOGS push efforts, requesting summary instead

6. All user messages (non-tool outputs):
   - "메모리 프로젝트 ?" (Memory project inquiry)
   - "2순위: 개발 중 (진행률 파악 필요) julia-compiler..." (Check progress on second priority)
   - "마무리" (Finish/wrap up)
   - "계슥 ." (Continue - with typo)
   - "프리랭에 주리아 이식 준비" (Prepare Julia port to FreeLang)
   - "프리랭 +주리아 흡수 주리아 라이브러리 문법 사용가능하게" (Full FreeLang + Julia integration with stdlib)
   - "좋아 진행" (Good, proceed)
   - "fj랭 공식 명칭" (Official name for FreeJulia)
   - Selected option "2" (FreeJulia as official name)
   - "고" (Go/proceed - abbreviated command)
   - "goga새저장소 모두 푸시" (Push all to new repository)
   - "https://gogs.dclub.kr/kim/freejulia.git" (GOGS repository URL)
   - "다시" (Try again)
   - "api토큰으로 푸시" (Push with API token)
   - "전역 설정 되어 있음" (Global config is set up)
   - "다시 찾아보기" (Search again)
   - "토큰을 찾아" (Find the token)
   - "kim / gogs-api-guide" (GOGS API guide repository reference)
   - "다시도" (Try again)
   - "토큰?" (What about the token?)
   - "다시도" (Try again)
   - "노 gogs 푸시" (No GOGS push)
   - "ㅎ? 왜 안될까" (What? Why won't it work)
   - "노 gogs 푸시" (No GOGS push - repeated)
   - "http 토큰으로" (With http token) - then immediately called for summary

7. Pending Tasks:
   - None explicitly stated. User has stopped GOGS push efforts and requested this summary, indicating the FreeJulia Phase A+B work is concluded locally.

8. Current Work:
   Phase A+B of FreeJulia project has been fully completed with:
   - 3,130 total lines of code (1,280 Phase A + 1,850 Phase B)
   - 193 total tests defined (53 Phase A + 140 Phase B)
   - 8 main implementation files created (types_extended.fl, dispatch.fl, arrays.fl, collections.fl, string.fl, math.fl, io.fl, plus BRAND.md)
   - Complete Julia stdlib compatibility mapping (70%+ achieved)
   - All code committed locally to master branch (9 commits, 17a97e80 HEAD)
   
   Most recent work before summary request:
   - Attempted to push to GOGS repository using HTTP token authentication
   - Received HTTP 413 error due to payload size (Go modules cache files)
   - User explicitly rejected further GOGS push attempts with "노 gogs 푸시"
   - Confirmed local repository status: "master is ahead of origin by 9 commits"
   - User then requested summary

9. Optional Next Step:
   Based on explicit user request "노 gogs 푸시" (No GOGS push), further push attempts should not be pursued. The local work is complete. If the user wants to continue development, the next phase would be Phase C (Julia Compiler Porting, 1,300 lines, 200+ tests) scheduled for 2026-03-26, but this should only be initiated upon explicit user request.

If you need specific details from before compaction (like exact code snippets, error messages, or content you generated), read the full transcript at: /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.claude/projects/-data-data-com-termux-files-home/1ac72970-2709-433c-9833-d0c9b7d78969.jsonl

GOGS 푸시 실패 원인:

## 1️⃣ **근본 원인: Go 모듈 캐시 포함**
현재 로컬 저장소에 **58,650개 파일 추가** (go/pkg/mod/ 전체)가 포함되어 있습니다.
- `go/pkg/mod/cache/download/` - 모듈 메타데이터
- `go/pkg/mod/github.com/*/` - 의존성 라이브러리들
- 총 크기: **약 150MB+**

## 2️⃣ **GOGS 서버 제한**
- **HTTP 413 에러**: Payload Too Large
- GOGS는 기본적으로 단일 푸시 페이로드 제한이 있음
- 사용자가 설정한 `http.postBuffer = 524288000` (500MB)도 도움이 안 됨

## 3️⃣ **해결 방법**

### 방법 A: Go 모듈 캐시 제외 (권장)
```bash
# .gitignore에 추가
echo "go/pkg/" >> .gitignore
```

### 방법 B: 별도 저장소 생성
- FreeJulia 코드만 새 저장소에 푸시
- projects/mandate-db 분리 등

### 방법 C: 얕은 푸시 (얕은 복제)
```bash
git push --depth=1
```

**어떤 방법으로 진행할까요?**

# 🚀 FreeLang에 Julia 컴파일러 이식 계획

**시작 날짜**: 2026-03-19
**목표 완료**: 2026-04-30 (6주)
**상태**: 🟢 계획 수립 중

---

## 📊 **현황 분석**

### Julia Compiler (Go) 현재 상태
| 항목 | 상태 |
|------|------|
| **언어** | Go 1.18+ |
| **코드량** | ~3,000줄 |
| **테스트** | 30+ (E2E + 벤치마크) |
| **아키텍처** | 8단계 파이프라인 |
| **버전** | v0.2.0 (Production Ready) |
| **커밋** | 79723259 |

**8단계 파이프라인**:
1. Lexing (토크나이제이션)
2. Parsing (AST 생성)
3. Semantic Analysis (의미 분석)
4. IR Generation (중간 표현)
5. Type Inference (타입 추론)
6. Optimization (최적화)
7. Code Generation (바이트코드 생성)
8. VM Execution (실행)

---

### FreeLang 현재 상태
| 항목 | 상태 |
|------|------|
| **언어** | FreeLang (자체 언어) |
| **표준 라이브러리** | Collections, String, IO, Math |
| **컴파일 대상** | C 언어 (프로덕션) |
| **자체호스팅** | ✅ 증명됨 (freelang-to-c) |
| **프로젝트** | freelang-to-c, freelang-library-extraction |

---

## 🎯 **이식 전략**

### Phase 1: 설계 & 분석 (Week 1)
**목표**: 이식 가능성 판단 및 설계 문서 작성

#### Task 1.1: Julia 컴파일러 구조 분석
```
목표: Go 코드의 모듈 구조를 FreeLang으로 매핑
산출물:
  - module-mapping.md (Go 모듈 → FreeLang 모듈)
  - interface-design.md (공개 인터페이스 설계)
  - type-system-mapping.md (Go 타입 → FreeLang 타입)

예시:
  Go: type Lexer struct { source string }
  FL: record Lexer { source: String }
```

#### Task 1.2: FreeLang 언어 기능 평가
```
목표: Julia 이식에 필요한 FreeLang 기능 확인
검증 항목:
  ✅ 배열/맵 (Go slice/map → FreeLang Array/Map)
  ✅ 구조체 (Go struct → FreeLang record)
  ✅ 에러 처리 (Go error → FreeLang Result/Option)
  ✅ 패턴 매칭 (Go switch → FreeLang match)
  ✅ 함수형 기능 (map/filter/fold 지원?)

가능성: 90% (대부분 FreeLang 기능으로 구현 가능)
```

#### Task 1.3: 이식 로드맵 작성
```
산출물: PORTING_ROADMAP.md
구성:
  - Phase별 마일스톤
  - 모듈별 우선순위
  - 리스크 및 대응 방안
  - 테스트 전략

  1. Token 타입 정의 (record)

  4. 도우미 함수 (isAlpha, isDigit 등)

테스트:
  - 50개 토큰 타입 검증

```

  1. AST 노드 정의 (record 타입)

의존성: Lexer 완료 필요

```

테스트: 14개 타입 검증 케이스
```

---

### Phase 3: 분석 & 생성 (Week 4-5)
**목표**: 중간 단계 모듈 이식

```

구현:
  1. Scope & Symbol Table
  2. Type Checking
  3. Error Reporting

테스트: 20개 의미 분석 케이스
```

#### Task 3.2: IR Builder 이식
```
Go 파일: internal/ir/builder.go (250줄)
FL 파일: freelang-julia/src/ir_builder.fl (320줄 예상)

구현:
  1. IR 노드 정의

  3. BasicBlock 생성 및 연결

테스트: IR 생성 검증 (15개 케이스)
```

#### Task 3.3: Code Generator 이식
```
Go 파일: internal/codegen/codegen.go (400줄)
FL 파일: freelang-julia/src/codegen.fl (500줄 예상)

구현:
  1. IR → Bytecode 변환
  2. Instruction 생성
  3. 바이트코드 시리얼화

테스트: 코드 생성 검증 (12개 케이스)
```

---

### Phase 4: 최적화 & 통합 (Week 6)
**목표**: 전체 파이프라인 완성 및 테스트

```

  3. nested: "2 * 3 + 4" → 10
  4. complex: 함수 호출, 루프 등

  - VM: 실행 결과 검증
```

#### Task 4.2: 성능 최적화
```
목표: Go 버전 수준의 성능 달성

최적화 대상:

let TokenArrow = "ARROW"
let TokenFatArrow = "FAT_ARROW"
let TokenBackslash = "BACKSLASH"
let TokenQuestion = "QUESTION"
let TokenDollar = "DOLLAR"
let TokenAmpersand = "AMPERSAND"
let TokenPipe = "PIPE"
let TokenDoublePipe = "DOUBLE_PIPE"
let TokenAmpersandAmpersand = "AMPERSAND_AMPERSAND"
let TokenXor = "XOR"
let TokenTilde = "TILDE"
let TokenLeftShift = "LEFT_SHIFT"
let TokenRightShift = "RIGHT_SHIFT"
let TokenEllipsis = "ELLIPSIS"

# ============================================================================
# Part 2: 키워드 매핑 (Dictionary)
# ============================================================================

function create_keywords(): Dict[String, String] =
  let keywords = dict([
    ("if", TokenIf),
    ("else", TokenElse),
    ("elseif", TokenElseif),
    ("end", TokenEnd),
    ("function", TokenFunction),
    ("return", TokenReturn),
    ("for", TokenFor),
    ("while", TokenWhile),
    ("break", TokenBreak),
    ("continue", TokenContinue),
    ("let", TokenLet),
    ("const", TokenConst),
    ("type", TokenType),
    ("struct", TokenStruct),
    ("module", TokenModule),
    ("using", TokenUsing),
    ("import", TokenImport),
    ("export", TokenExport),
    ("try", TokenTry),
    ("catch", TokenCatch),
    ("throw", TokenThrow),
    ("begin", TokenBegin),
    ("quote", TokenQuote),
    ("macro", TokenMacro),
    ("primitive", TokenPrimitive),
    ("abstract", TokenAbstract),
    ("mutable", TokenMutable),
    ("and", TokenAnd),
    ("or", TokenOr),
    ("not", TokenNot),
    ("in", TokenIn),
    ("true", TokenTrue),
    ("false", TokenFalse),
    ("nothing", TokenNothing),
    ("do", TokenDo),
  ])
  keywords

# ============================================================================
# Part 3: Lexer 구조체 및 기본 메서드
# ============================================================================

record Lexer {
  input: String,           # 입력 소스 코드
  pos: Int,                # 현재 위치
  line: Int,               # 현재 줄
  column: Int,             # 현재 열
  ch: String,              # 현재 문자 (1글자)
  file: String,            # 파일명
  keywords: Dict[String, String],  # 키워드 매핑
}

function new_lexer(input: String): Lexer =
  let keywords = create_keywords()
  let lexer = Lexer {
    input = input,
    pos = 0,
    line = 1,
    column = 0,
    ch = if input.length > 0 then input.substring(0, 1) else "",
    file = "<stdin>",
    keywords = keywords,
  }
  lexer

function new_lexer_with_file(input: String, filename: String): Lexer =
  let lex = new_lexer(input)
  Lexer {
    input = lex.input,
    pos = lex.pos,
    line = lex.line,
    column = lex.column,
    ch = lex.ch,
    file = filename,
    keywords = lex.keywords,
  }

# ============================================================================
# Part 4: 문자 읽기 헬퍼 메서드
# ============================================================================

function read_char(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if lexer.pos >= lexer.input.length then
    Lexer {
      input = lexer.input,
      pos = lexer.pos + 1,
      line = lexer.line,
      column = lexer.column + 1,
      ch = "",
      file = lexer.file,
      keywords = lexer.keywords,
    }
  else
    Lexer {
      input = lexer.input,
      pos = lexer.pos + 1,
      line = lexer.line,
      column = lexer.column + 1,
      ch = lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos, lexer.pos + 1),
      file = lexer.file,
      keywords = lexer.keywords,
    }

function peek_char(lexer: Lexer): String =
  if lexer.pos >= lexer.input.length then
    ""
  else
    lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos, lexer.pos + 1)

function peek_char_n(lexer: Lexer, n: Int): String =
  let pos = lexer.pos - 1 + n
  if pos >= lexer.input.length || pos < 0 then
    ""
  else
    lexer.input.substring(pos, pos + 1)

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  if ch.length == 0 then false
  else
    let code = ch.char_at(0)
    (code >= 65 && code <= 90) || (code >= 97 && code <= 122)

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  if ch.length == 0 then false
  else
    let code = ch.char_at(0)
    code >= 48 && code <= 57

function is_whitespace(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\r"

# ============================================================================
# Part 5: 주석 건너뛰기
# ============================================================================

function skip_whitespace(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if is_whitespace(lexer.ch) then
    skip_whitespace(read_char(lexer))
  else
    lexer

function skip_line_comment(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if lexer.ch == "#" && peek_char(lexer) != "=" then
    if lexer.ch == "\n" || lexer.ch == "" then
      lexer
    else
      skip_line_comment(read_char(lexer))
  else
    lexer

function skip_block_comment(lexer: Lexer, depth: Int): (Lexer, Bool) =
  if lexer.ch == "" then
    (lexer, true)  # 종료
  else if lexer.ch == "#" && peek_char(lexer) == "=" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    let lex3 = read_char(lex2)
    let (lex4, done) = skip_block_comment(lex3, depth + 1)
    (lex4, done)
  else if lexer.ch == "=" && peek_char(lexer) == "#" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    let lex3 = read_char(lex2)
    if depth == 1 then
      (lex3, true)
    else
      skip_block_comment(lex3, depth - 1)
  else
    let lex2 = if lexer.ch == "\n" then
      Lexer {
        input = lexer.input,
        pos = lexer.pos + 1,
        line = lexer.line + 1,
        column = 0,
        ch = if lexer.pos + 1 >= lexer.input.length then "" else lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos + 1, lexer.pos + 2),
        file = lexer.file,
        keywords = lexer.keywords,
      }
    else
      read_char(lexer)
    skip_block_comment(lex2, depth)

# ============================================================================
# Part 6: 토큰 읽기 메서드 (핵심)
# ============================================================================

function make_token(lexer: Lexer, token_type: String, lexeme: String): Token =
  Token {
    type = token_type,
    lexeme = lexeme,
    line = lexer.line,
    column = lexer.column,
  }

function read_string(lexer: Lexer, quote: String): (Lexer, Token) =
  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)  # 첫 따옴표 건너뛰기
  let start = lex2.pos - 1
  let (lex3, end) = read_string_loop(lex2, quote, start)
  let lexeme = if end > lex3.input.length then lex3.input.substring(start, lex3.input.length) else lex3.input.substring(start, end)
  (read_char(lex3), make_token(lex3, TokenString, lexeme))

function read_string_loop(lexer: Lexer, quote: String, start: Int): (Lexer, Int) =
  if lexer.ch == quote || lexer.ch == "" then
    (lexer, lexer.pos)
  else
    let lex2 = if lexer.ch == "\\" then read_char(lexer) else lexer
    let lex3 = if lex2.ch == "\n" then
      Lexer {
        input = lex2.input,
        pos = lex2.pos,
        line = lex2.line + 1,
        column = 0,
        ch = lex2.ch,
        file = lex2.file,
        keywords = lex2.keywords,
      }
    else
      lex2
    let lex4 = read_char(lex3)
    read_string_loop(lex4, quote, start)

function read_number(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let start = lexer.pos - 1
  let (lex2, is_float, is_complex, is_rational) = read_number_parts(lexer)
  let end = lex2.pos
  let lexeme = if end > lex2.input.length then lex2.input.substring(start, lex2.input.length) else lex2.input.substring(start, end)
  let token_type = if is_complex then
    TokenComplexNumber
  else if is_rational then
    TokenRationalNumber
  else if is_float then
    TokenFloat
  else
    TokenInteger
  (lex2, make_token(lex2, token_type, lexeme))

function read_number_parts(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Bool, Bool, Bool) =
  # 정수 부분
  let (lex1, _) = read_while(lexer, is_digit)

  # 부동소수점
  let (lex2, is_float) = if lex1.ch == "." && is_digit(peek_char(lex1)) then
    let lex2a = read_char(lex1)
    let (lex2b, _) = read_while(lex2a, is_digit)
    (lex2b, true)
  else
    (lex1, false)

  # 지수 표기법
  let (lex3, is_float2) = if (lex2.ch == "e" || lex2.ch == "E") && (is_digit(peek_char(lex2)) || peek_char(lex2) == "+" || peek_char(lex2) == "-") then
    let lex3a = read_char(lex2)
    let lex3b = if lex3a.ch == "+" || lex3a.ch == "-" then read_char(lex3a) else lex3a
    let (lex3c, _) = read_while(lex3b, is_digit)
    (lex3c, true)
  else
    (lex2, false)

  let is_float_final = is_float || is_float2

  # 복소수 (im)
  let (lex4, is_complex) = if lex3.ch == "i" && peek_char(lex3) == "m" then
    (read_char(read_char(lex3)), true)
  else
    (lex3, false)

  # 유리수 (//)
  let (lex5, is_rational) = if lex4.ch == "/" && peek_char(lex4) == "/" then
    let lex5a = read_char(read_char(lex4))
    let (lex5b, _) = read_while(lex5a, is_digit)
    (lex5b, true)
  else
    (lex4, false)

  (lex5, is_float_final, is_complex, is_rational)

function read_while(lexer: Lexer, predicate: (String) -> Bool): (Lexer, Int) =
  if predicate(lexer.ch) then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    read_while(lex2, predicate)
  else
    (lexer, lexer.pos)

function read_identifier_or_keyword(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let start = lexer.pos - 1
  let (lex2, _) = read_identifier_chars(lexer)
  let end = lex2.pos - 1
  let lexeme = if end > lex2.input.length then lex2.input.substring(start, lex2.input.length) else lex2.input.substring(start, end)
  let token_type = match lookup(lexer.keywords, lexeme) {
    Some(tt) -> tt,
    None -> TokenIdentifier,
  }
  (lex2, make_token(lex2, token_type, lexeme))

function read_identifier_chars(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Int) =
  if is_alpha(lexer.ch) || is_digit(lexer.ch) || lexer.ch == "_" || lexer.ch == "!" || lexer.ch == "?" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    read_identifier_chars(lex2)
  else
    (lexer, lexer.pos)

function read_symbol(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)  # ':'
  let start = lex2.pos
  let (lex3, _) = read_symbol_chars(lex2)
  let end = lex3.pos
  let lexeme = ":" + (if end > lex3.input.length then lex3.input.substring(start, lex3.input.length) else lex3.input.substring(start, end))
  (lex3, make_token(lex3, TokenSymbol, lexeme))

function read_symbol_chars(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Int) =
  if is_alpha(lexer.ch) || is_digit(lexer.ch) || lexer.ch == "_" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    read_symbol_chars(lex2)
  else
    (lexer, lexer.pos)

# ============================================================================
# Part 7: 메인 Tokenize 함수 (NextToken)
# ============================================================================

function next_token(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let lex1 = skip_whitespace(lexer)

  # 주석 처리
  let lex2 = skip_comments(lex1)

  # EOF
  if lex2.ch == "" then
    (lex2, make_token(lex2, TokenEOF, ""))

  # 개행
  else if lex2.ch == "\n" then
    let lex3 = Lexer {
      input = lex2.input,
      pos = lex2.pos + 1,
      line = lex2.line + 1,
      column = 0,
      ch = if lex2.pos + 1 >= lex2.input.length then "" else lex2.input.substring(lex2.pos + 1, lex2.pos + 2),
      file = lex2.file,
      keywords = lex2.keywords,
    }
    (lex3, make_token(lex2, TokenNewline, "\n"))

  # 문자열
  else if lex2.ch == "\"" || lex2.ch == "'" then
    read_string(lex2, lex2.ch)

  # 숫자
  else if is_digit(lex2.ch) then
    read_number(lex2)

  # 심볼 (:name)
  else if lex2.ch == ":" && is_alpha(peek_char(lex2)) then
    read_symbol(lex2)

  # 식별자 또는 키워드
  else if is_alpha(lex2.ch) || lex2.ch == "_" then
    read_identifier_or_keyword(lex2)

  # 연산자 및 구분자
  else
    read_operator_or_delimiter(lex2)

function skip_comments(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if lexer.ch == "#" then
    if peek_char(lexer) == "=" then
      let (lex2, _) = skip_block_comment(lexer, 1)
      let lex3 = skip_whitespace(lex2)
      skip_comments(lex3)
    else
      let lex2 = skip_line_comment(lexer)
      let lex3 = skip_whitespace(lex2)
      skip_comments(lex3)
  else
    lexer

function read_operator_or_delimiter(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let ch = lexer.ch
  let next = peek_char(lexer)
  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)

  match ch {
    "+" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPlusAssign, "+="))
      else if next == "+" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPlusPlus, "++"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenPlus, "+")),

    "-" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenMinusAssign, "-="))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenMinus, "-")),

    "*" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenStarAssign, "*="))
      else if next == "*" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPower, "^"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenStar, "*")),

    "/" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenSlashAssign, "/="))
      else if next == "/" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoubleSlash, "//"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenSlash, "/")),

    "=" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenEqual, "=="))
      else if next == ">" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenFatArrow, "=>"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenAssign, "=")),

    "!" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenNotEqual, "!="))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenNot, "!")),

    "<" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenLessEqual, "<="))
      else if next == "<" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenLeftShift, "<<"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLess, "<")),

    ">" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenGreaterEqual, ">="))
      else if next == ">" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenRightShift, ">>"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenGreater, ">")),

    "(" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftParen, "(")),
    ")" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightParen, ")")),
    "[" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftBracket, "[")),
    "]" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightBracket, "]")),
    "{" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftBrace, "{")),
    "}" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightBrace, "}")),
    "," -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenComma, ",")),
    ";" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenSemicolon, ";")),
    "." ->
      if next == "." && peek_char_n(lexer, 2) == "." then
        (read_char(read_char(lex2)), make_token(lexer, TokenEllipsis, "..."))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenDot, ".")),
    ":" ->
      if next == ":" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoubleColon, "::"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenColon, ":")),
    "?" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenQuestion, "?")),
    "\\" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenBackslash, "\\")),
    "$" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenDollar, "$")),
    "&" ->
      if next == "&" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenAmpersandAmpersand, "&&"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenAmpersand, "&")),
    "|" ->
      if next == "|" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoublePipe, "||"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenPipe, "|")),
    "^" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenXor, "^")),
    "~" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenTilde, "~")),
    _ -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, "UNKNOWN", ch)),
  }

# ============================================================================
# Part 8: 전체 토크나이제이션 (Tokenize)
# ============================================================================

function tokenize(lexer: Lexer): [Token] =
  tokenize_loop(lexer, [])

function tokenize_loop(lexer: Lexer, tokens: [Token]): [Token] =
  let (lex2, token) = next_token(lexer)
  let tokens2 = tokens.push(token)

  if token.type == TokenEOF then
    tokens2
  else
    tokenize_loop(lex2, tokens2)

  keywords

# ============================================================================
# Part 3: Lexer 구조체 및 기본 메서드
# ============================================================================

record Lexer {
  input: String,           # 입력 소스 코드
  pos: Int,                # 현재 위치
  line: Int,               # 현재 줄
  column: Int,             # 현재 열
  ch: String,              # 현재 문자 (1글자)
  file: String,            # 파일명
  keywords: Dict[String, String],  # 키워드 매핑
}

function new_lexer(input: String): Lexer =
  let keywords = create_keywords()
  let lexer = Lexer {
    input = input,
    pos = 0,
    line = 1,
    column = 0,
    ch = if input.length > 0 then input.substring(0, 1) else "",
    file = "<stdin>",
    keywords = keywords,
  }
  lexer

function new_lexer_with_file(input: String, filename: String): Lexer =
  let lex = new_lexer(input)
  Lexer {
    input = lex.input,
    pos = lex.pos,
    line = lex.line,
    column = lex.column,
    ch = lex.ch,
    file = filename,
    keywords = lex.keywords,
  }

# ============================================================================
# Part 4: 문자 읽기 헬퍼 메서드
# ============================================================================

function read_char(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if lexer.pos >= lexer.input.length then
    Lexer {
      input = lexer.input,
      pos = lexer.pos + 1,
      line = lexer.line,
      column = lexer.column + 1,
      ch = "",
      file = lexer.file,
      keywords = lexer.keywords,
    }
  else
    Lexer {
      input = lexer.input,
      pos = lexer.pos + 1,
      line = lexer.line,
      column = lexer.column + 1,
      ch = lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos, lexer.pos + 1),
      file = lexer.file,
      keywords = lexer.keywords,
    }

function peek_char(lexer: Lexer): String =
  if lexer.pos >= lexer.input.length then
    ""
  else
    lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos, lexer.pos + 1)

function peek_char_n(lexer: Lexer, n: Int): String =
  let pos = lexer.pos - 1 + n
  if pos >= lexer.input.length || pos < 0 then
    ""
  else
    lexer.input.substring(pos, pos + 1)

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  if ch.length == 0 then false
  else
    let code = ch.char_at(0)
    (code >= 65 && code <= 90) || (code >= 97 && code <= 122)

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  if ch.length == 0 then false
  else
    let code = ch.char_at(0)
    code >= 48 && code <= 57

function is_whitespace(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\r"

# ============================================================================
# Part 5: 주석 건너뛰기
# ============================================================================

function skip_whitespace(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if is_whitespace(lexer.ch) then
    skip_whitespace(read_char(lexer))
  else
    lexer

function skip_line_comment(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if lexer.ch == "#" && peek_char(lexer) != "=" then
    if lexer.ch == "\n" || lexer.ch == "" then
      lexer
    else
      skip_line_comment(read_char(lexer))
  else
    lexer

function skip_block_comment(lexer: Lexer, depth: Int): (Lexer, Bool) =
  if lexer.ch == "" then
    (lexer, true)  # 종료
  else if lexer.ch == "#" && peek_char(lexer) == "=" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    let lex3 = read_char(lex2)
    let (lex4, done) = skip_block_comment(lex3, depth + 1)
    (lex4, done)
  else if lexer.ch == "=" && peek_char(lexer) == "#" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    let lex3 = read_char(lex2)
    if depth == 1 then
      (lex3, true)
    else
      skip_block_comment(lex3, depth - 1)
  else
    let lex2 = if lexer.ch == "\n" then
      Lexer {
        input = lexer.input,
        pos = lexer.pos + 1,
        line = lexer.line + 1,
        column = 0,
        ch = if lexer.pos + 1 >= lexer.input.length then "" else lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos + 1, lexer.pos + 2),
        file = lexer.file,
        keywords = lexer.keywords,
      }
    else
      read_char(lexer)
    skip_block_comment(lex2, depth)

# ============================================================================
# Part 6: 토큰 읽기 메서드 (핵심)
# ============================================================================

function make_token(lexer: Lexer, token_type: String, lexeme: String): Token =
  Token {
    type = token_type,
    lexeme = lexeme,
    line = lexer.line,
    column = lexer.column,
  }

function read_string(lexer: Lexer, quote: String): (Lexer, Token) =
  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)  # 첫 따옴표 건너뛰기
  let start = lex2.pos - 1
  let (lex3, end) = read_string_loop(lex2, quote, start)
  let lexeme = if end > lex3.input.length then lex3.input.substring(start, lex3.input.length) else lex3.input.substring(start, end)
  (read_char(lex3), make_token(lex3, TokenString, lexeme))

function read_string_loop(lexer: Lexer, quote: String, start: Int): (Lexer, Int) =
  if lexer.ch == quote || lexer.ch == "" then
    (lexer, lexer.pos)
  else
    let lex2 = if lexer.ch == "\\" then read_char(lexer) else lexer
    let lex3 = if lex2.ch == "\n" then
      Lexer {
        input = lex2.input,
        pos = lex2.pos,
        line = lex2.line + 1,
        column = 0,
        ch = lex2.ch,
        file = lex2.file,
        keywords = lex2.keywords,
      }
    else
      lex2
    let lex4 = read_char(lex3)
    read_string_loop(lex4, quote, start)

function read_number(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let start = lexer.pos - 1
  let (lex2, is_float, is_complex, is_rational) = read_number_parts(lexer)
  let end = lex2.pos
  let lexeme = if end > lex2.input.length then lex2.input.substring(start, lex2.input.length) else lex2.input.substring(start, end)
  let token_type = if is_complex then
    TokenComplexNumber
  else if is_rational then
    TokenRationalNumber
  else if is_float then
    TokenFloat
  else
    TokenInteger
  (lex2, make_token(lex2, token_type, lexeme))

function read_number_parts(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Bool, Bool, Bool) =
  # 정수 부분
  let (lex1, _) = read_while(lexer, is_digit)

  # 부동소수점
  let (lex2, is_float) = if lex1.ch == "." && is_digit(peek_char(lex1)) then
    let lex2a = read_char(lex1)
    let (lex2b, _) = read_while(lex2a, is_digit)
    (lex2b, true)
  else
    (lex1, false)

  # 지수 표기법
  let (lex3, is_float2) = if (lex2.ch == "e" || lex2.ch == "E") && (is_digit(peek_char(lex2)) || peek_char(lex2) == "+" || peek_char(lex2) == "-") then
    let lex3a = read_char(lex2)
    let lex3b = if lex3a.ch == "+" || lex3a.ch == "-" then read_char(lex3a) else lex3a
    let (lex3c, _) = read_while(lex3b, is_digit)
    (lex3c, true)
  else
    (lex2, false)

  let is_float_final = is_float || is_float2

  # 복소수 (im)
  let (lex4, is_complex) = if lex3.ch == "i" && peek_char(lex3) == "m" then
    (read_char(read_char(lex3)), true)
  else
    (lex3, false)

  # 유리수 (//)
  let (lex5, is_rational) = if lex4.ch == "/" && peek_char(lex4) == "/" then
    let lex5a = read_char(read_char(lex4))
    let (lex5b, _) = read_while(lex5a, is_digit)
    (lex5b, true)
  else
    (lex4, false)

  (lex5, is_float_final, is_complex, is_rational)

function read_while(lexer: Lexer, predicate: (String) -> Bool): (Lexer, Int) =
  if predicate(lexer.ch) then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    read_while(lex2, predicate)
  else
    (lexer, lexer.pos)

function read_identifier_or_keyword(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let start = lexer.pos - 1
  let (lex2, _) = read_identifier_chars(lexer)
  let end = lex2.pos - 1
  let lexeme = if end > lex2.input.length then lex2.input.substring(start, lex2.input.length) else lex2.input.substring(start, end)
  let token_type = match lookup(lexer.keywords, lexeme) {
    Some(tt) -> tt,
    None -> TokenIdentifier,
  }
  (lex2, make_token(lex2, token_type, lexeme))

function read_identifier_chars(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Int) =
  if is_alpha(lexer.ch) || is_digit(lexer.ch) || lexer.ch == "_" || lexer.ch == "!" || lexer.ch == "?" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    read_identifier_chars(lex2)
  else
    (lexer, lexer.pos)

function read_symbol(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)  # ':'
  let start = lex2.pos
  let (lex3, _) = read_symbol_chars(lex2)
  let end = lex3.pos
  let lexeme = ":" + (if end > lex3.input.length then lex3.input.substring(start, lex3.input.length) else lex3.input.substring(start, end))
  (lex3, make_token(lex3, TokenSymbol, lexeme))

function read_symbol_chars(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Int) =
  if is_alpha(lexer.ch) || is_digit(lexer.ch) || lexer.ch == "_" then
    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
    read_symbol_chars(lex2)
  else
    (lexer, lexer.pos)

# ============================================================================
# Part 7: 메인 Tokenize 함수 (NextToken)
# ============================================================================

function next_token(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let lex1 = skip_whitespace(lexer)

  # 주석 처리
  let lex2 = skip_comments(lex1)

  # EOF
  if lex2.ch == "" then
    (lex2, make_token(lex2, TokenEOF, ""))

  # 개행
  else if lex2.ch == "\n" then
    let lex3 = Lexer {
      input = lex2.input,
      pos = lex2.pos + 1,
      line = lex2.line + 1,
      column = 0,
      ch = if lex2.pos + 1 >= lex2.input.length then "" else lex2.input.substring(lex2.pos + 1, lex2.pos + 2),
      file = lex2.file,
      keywords = lex2.keywords,
    }
    (lex3, make_token(lex2, TokenNewline, "\n"))

  # 문자열
  else if lex2.ch == "\"" || lex2.ch == "'" then
    read_string(lex2, lex2.ch)

  # 숫자
  else if is_digit(lex2.ch) then
    read_number(lex2)

  # 심볼 (:name)
  else if lex2.ch == ":" && is_alpha(peek_char(lex2)) then
    read_symbol(lex2)

  # 식별자 또는 키워드
  else if is_alpha(lex2.ch) || lex2.ch == "_" then
    read_identifier_or_keyword(lex2)

  # 연산자 및 구분자
  else
    read_operator_or_delimiter(lex2)

function skip_comments(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
  if lexer.ch == "#" then
    if peek_char(lexer) == "=" then
      let (lex2, _) = skip_block_comment(lexer, 1)
      let lex3 = skip_whitespace(lex2)
      skip_comments(lex3)
    else
      let lex2 = skip_line_comment(lexer)
      let lex3 = skip_whitespace(lex2)
      skip_comments(lex3)
  else
    lexer

function read_operator_or_delimiter(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
  let ch = lexer.ch
  let next = peek_char(lexer)
  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)

  match ch {
    "+" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPlusAssign, "+="))
      else if next == "+" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPlusPlus, "++"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenPlus, "+")),

    "-" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenMinusAssign, "-="))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenMinus, "-")),

    "*" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenStarAssign, "*="))
      else if next == "*" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPower, "^"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenStar, "*")),

    "/" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenSlashAssign, "/="))
      else if next == "/" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoubleSlash, "//"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenSlash, "/")),

    "=" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenEqual, "=="))
      else if next == ">" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenFatArrow, "=>"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenAssign, "=")),

    "!" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenNotEqual, "!="))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenNot, "!")),

    "<" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenLessEqual, "<="))
      else if next == "<" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenLeftShift, "<<"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLess, "<")),

    ">" ->
      if next == "=" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenGreaterEqual, ">="))
      else if next == ">" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenRightShift, ">>"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenGreater, ">")),

    "(" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftParen, "(")),
    ")" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightParen, ")")),
    "[" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftBracket, "[")),
    "]" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightBracket, "]")),
    "{" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftBrace, "{")),
    "}" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightBrace, "}")),
    "," -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenComma, ",")),
    ";" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenSemicolon, ";")),
    "." ->
      if next == "." && peek_char_n(lexer, 2) == "." then
        (read_char(read_char(lex2)), make_token(lexer, TokenEllipsis, "..."))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenDot, ".")),
    ":" ->
      if next == ":" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoubleColon, "::"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenColon, ":")),
    "?" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenQuestion, "?")),
    "\\" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenBackslash, "\\")),
    "$" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenDollar, "$")),
    "&" ->
      if next == "&" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenAmpersandAmpersand, "&&"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenAmpersand, "&")),
    "|" ->
      if next == "|" then
        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoublePipe, "||"))
      else
        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenPipe, "|")),
    "^" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenXor, "^")),
    "~" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenTilde, "~")),
    _ -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, "UNKNOWN", ch)),
  }

# ============================================================================
# Part 8: 전체 토크나이제이션 (Tokenize)
# ============================================================================

function tokenize(lexer: Lexer): [Token] =
  tokenize_loop(lexer, [])

function tokenize_loop(lexer: Lexer, tokens: [Token]): [Token] =
  let (lex2, token) = next_token(lexer)
  let tokens2 = tokens.push(token)

  if token.type == TokenEOF then
    tokens2
  else
    tokenize_loop(lex2, tokens2)

**Part 3: Lexer 구조체 & 기본 메서드**
```
record Lexer {
  input: String,           # 입력 소스 코드
  pos: Int,                # 현재 위치
  line: Int,               # 현재 줄

# ============================================================================
# Phase C Task C.3: Julia Type System 이식 (FreeLang 구현)
# ============================================================================
# Julia 컴파일러의 타입 시스템(Type System) 모듈을 FreeLang으로 이식합니다.
#
# 기능:
# - 30+ 기본 타입 정의
# - 타입 계층구조 (Subtype relationships)
# - 복합 타입 (Array, Function, Tuple 등)
# - 타입 호환성 검사
# - 타입 레지스트리
#
# 목표: Go 타입 시스템과 100% 호환
# 규모: 420줄 (구현 + 테스트)
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# Part 1: TypeKind 정의 (30+ 타입)
# ============================================================================

# 기본 타입 상수
let KindAny = "Any"
let KindNothing = "Nothing"
let KindBool = "Bool"
let KindType = "Type"

# 정수 타입
let KindInt8 = "Int8"
let KindInt16 = "Int16"
let KindInt32 = "Int32"
let KindInt64 = "Int64"
let KindUInt8 = "UInt8"
let KindUInt16 = "UInt16"
let KindUInt32 = "UInt32"
let KindUInt64 = "UInt64"

# 부동소수점 타입
let KindFloat32 = "Float32"
let KindFloat64 = "Float64"

# 복소수 타입
let KindComplex64 = "Complex64"
let KindComplex128 = "Complex128"

# 숫자 union 타입
let KindInteger = "Integer"
let KindNumber = "Number"
let KindFloating = "Floating"
let KindSigned = "Signed"
let KindUnsigned = "Unsigned"

# 문자 및 문자열
let KindString = "String"
let KindChar = "Char"
let KindSymbol = "Symbol"

# 컨테이너 타입
let KindArray = "Array"
let KindVector = "Vector"
let KindMatrix = "Matrix"
let KindTuple = "Tuple"
let KindDict = "Dict"
let KindSet = "Set"

# 함수 타입
let KindFunction = "Function"

# 사용자 정의 타입
let KindStruct = "Struct"
let KindMutableStruct = "MutableStruct"
let KindUnion = "Union"

# 추상 타입
let KindAbstract = "Abstract"

# ============================================================================
# Part 2: BasicType 정의
# ============================================================================

record BasicType {
  kind: String,      # 타입 종류
  name: String,      # 타입 이름
  size: Int,         # 메모리 크기 (바이트)
}

function new_basic_type(kind: String, name: String, size: Int): BasicType =
  BasicType {
    kind = kind,
    name = name,
    size = size,
  }

function type_kind(t: BasicType): String =
  t.kind

function type_name(t: BasicType): String =
  t.name

function type_size(t: BasicType): Int =
  t.size

function type_string(t: BasicType): String =
  t.name

# ============================================================================
# Part 3: 복합 타입
# ============================================================================

record ArrayType {
  element_type: BasicType,
  dimensions: Int,
}

record FunctionType {
  param_types: [BasicType],
  return_type: BasicType,
}

record TupleType {
  element_types: [BasicType],
}

record UnionType {
  types: [BasicType],
}

# ============================================================================
# Part 4: 타입 호환성 검사
# ============================================================================

function is_subtype_of(t1: BasicType, t2: BasicType): Bool =
  # 직접 매칭
  if t1.kind == t2.kind then
    true
  # Any는 모든 타입의 상위
  else if t2.kind == KindAny then
    true
  # Nothing은 모든 타입의 하위
  else if t1.kind == KindNothing then
    true
  # 정수 타입 계층
  else if is_integer_type(t1.kind) && is_integer_type(t2.kind) then
    is_integer_compatible(t1.kind, t2.kind)
  # 부동소수점 타입 계층
  else if is_float_type(t1.kind) && is_float_type(t2.kind) then
    is_float_compatible(t1.kind, t2.kind)
  # 숫자 union 타입
  else if is_numeric_union(t2.kind) then
    is_numeric_subtype(t1.kind, t2.kind)
  else
    false

function is_integer_type(kind: String): Bool =
  kind == KindInt8 ||
  kind == KindInt16 ||
  kind == KindInt32 ||
  kind == KindInt64 ||
  kind == KindUInt8 ||
  kind == KindUInt16 ||
  kind == KindUInt32 ||
  kind == KindUInt64

function is_float_type(kind: String): Bool =
  kind == KindFloat32 ||
  kind == KindFloat64

function is_integer_compatible(k1: String, k2: String): Bool =
  if k2 == KindInteger then
    is_integer_type(k1)
  else if k2 == KindSigned then
    k1 == KindInt8 || k1 == KindInt16 || k1 == KindInt32 || k1 == KindInt64
  else if k2 == KindUnsigned then
    k1 == KindUInt8 || k1 == KindUInt16 || k1 == KindUInt32 || k1 == KindUInt64
  else
    k1 == k2

function is_float_compatible(k1: String, k2: String): Bool =
  if k2 == KindFloating then
    is_float_type(k1)
  else
    k1 == k2

function is_numeric_union(kind: String): Bool =
  kind == KindNumber ||
  kind == KindInteger ||
  kind == KindFloating ||
  kind == KindSigned ||
  kind == KindUnsigned

function is_numeric_subtype(kind: String, numeric_union: String): Bool =
  if numeric_union == KindNumber then
    is_integer_type(kind) || is_float_type(kind) || is_complex_type(kind)
  else if numeric_union == KindInteger then
    is_integer_type(kind)
  else if numeric_union == KindFloating then
    is_float_type(kind)
  else if numeric_union == KindSigned then
    kind == KindInt8 || kind == KindInt16 || kind == KindInt32 || kind == KindInt64
  else if numeric_union == KindUnsigned then
    kind == KindUInt8 || kind == KindUInt16 || kind == KindUInt32 || kind == KindUInt64
  else
    false

function is_complex_type(kind: String): Bool =
  kind == KindComplex64 || kind == KindComplex128

# ============================================================================
# Part 5: 타입 레지스트리
# ============================================================================

record TypeRegistry {
  types: Dict[String, BasicType],
  primitives: Dict[String, BasicType],
}

function new_registry(): TypeRegistry =
  let primitive_types = [
    new_basic_type(KindAny, "Any", 0),
    new_basic_type(KindNothing, "Nothing", 0),
    new_basic_type(KindBool, "Bool", 1),
    new_basic_type(KindType, "Type", 8),
    new_basic_type(KindInt8, "Int8", 1),
    new_basic_type(KindInt16, "Int16", 2),
    new_basic_type(KindInt32, "Int32", 4),
    new_basic_type(KindInt64, "Int64", 8),
    new_basic_type(KindUInt8, "UInt8", 1),
    new_basic_type(KindUInt16, "UInt16", 2),
    new_basic_type(KindUInt32, "UInt32", 4),
    new_basic_type(KindUInt64, "UInt64", 8),
    new_basic_type(KindFloat32, "Float32", 4),
    new_basic_type(KindFloat64, "Float64", 8),
    new_basic_type(KindComplex64, "Complex64", 8),
    new_basic_type(KindComplex128, "Complex128", 16),
    new_basic_type(KindInteger, "Integer", 0),
    new_basic_type(KindNumber, "Number", 0),
    new_basic_type(KindFloating, "Floating", 0),
